notes: 9.7 accepted only the `information` spelling and had no `group` list keyword; 9.8.54 accepts `info`, `information` (same table) and `group`.
`group` the list keyword prints the Slot:Groupname table; the sibling command 'massflow mine-block group' is what assigns groups.

keywords.name: extra
keywords.description: List extra-variable information from slot i (1 to 128).

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: List mine-block group names (ID and Slot:Groupname table).

keywords.name: info
keywords.description: List the per-object information table. The 9.8 manual's documented spelling; `information` is also accepted.

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-10 on MassFlow 9.8.54 (GUI bridge) (state grade): 'massflow mine-block list info|information|group' each printed its own table header (Mine-Block information / Mine-Block Groups) on an empty model; bogus tokens are reported as unused AFTER the bare list has run.
